_comment: Ed25519 seeds for development and tests. NOTHING in this file is secret.
The '2026-10' entry is a PLACEHOLDER so dev builds and the preview site can sign and verify tokens.
Before launch: run `cargo xtask keygen`, put the new public key in crates/cia-license/src/keys.rs under kid 2026-10,
set LICENSE_SIGNING_KEY on Vercel to the printed seed, and DELETE the 2026-10 entry below. The real seed must never be committed.
The 'test' entry signs packages/api-types/test-vectors/license-tokens.json and is only trusted in test / e2e builds.
